title: James Boyle (SR Inc., Dignity First Leadership author) — Incorruptible as the board-level system corporate-sustainability directors have been missing
summary: James Boyle — Director of Corporate Sustainability and author of Dignity First Leadership — publishes a long-form review on SR Inc.'s Sustainable Leadership Blog. Argues corporate-sustainability directors have spent a decade building cross-functional SteerCos but have not pursued the deeper structural change to corporate governance itself — and that Incorruptible hands them exactly the rigorous, board-level system they've been missing, using Costco's 98% shareholder rejection of a January 2025 anti-DEI proposal as the case that resilience is structure, not personality.
blockquote: Eric Ries's new book, "Incorruptible . . . how Great Companies Stay Great" offers exactly that: a fully developed process and system of recommendations for building greater than financial purpose permanently into a company's charter, ownership, and board.
attribution_title: Director of Corporate Sustainability, SR Inc.; author, Dignity First Leadership
